lines.t:
A classification of the ability needed to handle <c:ffff00>{{part|pl}}<c>
<c:ffff00>actions<c> and <c:ffff00>Drive<c>, in 6 types: <c:ffff00>Striking<c>, <c:ffff00>Shooting<c>,
<c:ffff00>Support<c>, <c:ffff00>Heal<c>, <c:ffff00>Block<c> and <c:ffff00>Set-up<c>. Striking and
Shooting are <c:ffff00>offensive<c>; the rest are <c:ffff00>support type<c>.
Each matches one of the <c:ffff00>{{medal}}<c>'s 6 <c:ffff00>skill levels<c> and
affects the speed of <c:ffff00>{{prep}}<c> and <c:ffff00>{{cooldown}}<c> and the
{{effect}}.
<c:ffff00>Special<c> {{part|pl}} belong to no skill and ignore skill
levels.
